mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies today near the Verona Public Library with a pleasant temperature of 79 degrees.

The city has a lot going on. Mayor Diaz has proclaimed September as National Senior Center Month to honor our seniors. Also, the Senior Center is currently managing meal orders and offering a wide variety of fitness classes, from chair yoga to bicycle rides, to keep everyone active and healthy.

There is plenty to do in town. Today features the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, Yoga at Insight Wellness, and live music at Paddy Mac's, plus pizza at Lake Lou-ee and trivia at The Bogey Factory. Looking ahead, you can catch Hop Haus Trivia tomorrow, live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee on August 28, the Dane County Farmer's Market on August 29, and the Kids Triathlon on August 30.

Regarding local activity, on August 21, a police officer conducted a traffic stop for an expired registration and subsequently cited the driver for possession of marijuana after smelling the substance in the vehicle.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Mint Cookie. The restaurant is currently open and serving guests until 11 PM, so make sure to stop by soon.
